scope: 默认分支、README 已提取目标及已有安装映射；不穷举历史版本、不安装或执行插件

description.en: Session titles follow the latest task automatically; names you set by hand stay put.
description.zh: 会话标题跟随最新任务自动更新，你手动改过的名字不会被覆盖。

description.en: Commit workspace changes from the conversation header, with the model grouping the commits.
description.zh: 从会话顶栏提交工作区改动，由模型分组。

description.en: A reviewer model answers approval requests; only calls that pass go ahead, one call at a time.
description.zh: 需要审批的请求交给审核模型判断，通过才放行这一次调用。

description.en: Find and read sessions, copy thread IDs, and use temporary workspaces; continue with one tap on an empty composer and get a welcome-back recap after time away.
description.zh: 查找和阅读会话，复制线程 ID，使用临时工作区；空输入一键继续，久离回来给出摘要与压缩建议。

description.en: Change the models used by plugins and subagents from one page, and see each running subagent's model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 在一个页面修改各插件和子代理使用的模型，并查看运行中子代理的模型与思考强度。

description.en: Manage web search providers and public-page fetching from one settings page.
description.zh: 在一个设置页管理搜索供应商与公开页面抓取。

description.en: Zhihu search, agent tools, knowledge bases, and usage tracking.
description.zh: 知乎搜索、智能体工具、知识库和用量统计。

description.en: Use ChatGPT web search, image generation, editing, and image analysis through local Codex.
description.zh: 借助本机 Codex 使用 ChatGPT 网络搜索、生图、改图和图片分析。

description.en: Search the web and create images and videos with the local Grok Build CLI.
description.zh: 通过本机 Grok Build 搜索网页、生成和编辑图片、生成视频。

description.en: Search, create images, video and speech, and understand audio and video through MiniMax Code.
description.zh: 通过 MiniMax Code 搜索资料、生成图片视频和配音、转写及理解音视频。

description.en: Customize the interface font, code font, and conversation font size of the Web GUI.
description.zh: 自定义 Web GUI 的界面字体、代码字体与会话字号。

description.en: A session preset that delivers complete results; every other session stays untouched.
description.zh: 直接交付完整成果的会话 Preset；其他会话保持原样。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugins on npm and GitHub with native tools.
description.zh: 在插件页读 DSH 官方文档；创造模式用原生工具查文档，查核 npm 与 GitHub 上的插件。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugins on npm and GitHub with native tools.
description.zh: 在插件页读 DSH 官方文档；创造模式用原生工具查文档，查核 npm 与 GitHub 上的插件。
